notes.title: patch note 1.0.4
notes.content: 1. Fix a bug when you open a diary log and pause menu at the same time, the mouse will disappear when  you click on "resume" and the diary log stays on the screen forever.

notes.title: patch note bug fix 1.0.3
notes.content:
1. Fix the weapon condition is not update properly in the inventory UI
2. Melee weapons now will be destroyed when it condition comes down to 0
3. Add a few more resources across the map ( note: you can open most of the drawers, closets for more resources :) )
4. Add a new item: bottle of oil, it will be used to burn down wooden blocks together with lighter. 

Planning on adding Steam achievements next week.
